dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge follows a concave spline, transitioning from a steep descent at the apex to a more horizontal orientation at the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The highest morphological point exhibits a rounded pixel radius, lacking acute or sharp tapering.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin presents a steep linear ascent at approximately 65 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the fin's maximum base width to its maximum vertical height is approximately 1.7:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Numerous small, white punctate speckles are distributed across the lateral surface of the dorsal fin and the adjacent dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Strong specular highlights are visible on the wet surface of the skin along the anterior portion of the dorsal ridge.
